Added


- CalDAV calendars (Fastmail, Nextcloud and others) are now available to everyone, no beta needed.
- Daily Planning can finish on Today, or in Focus on your first task, instead of Home. Set it in Rituals settings.
- Autoplan open loops: research now surfaces reviews, messages and emails waiting on you, and the briefing tells you what it didn't act on and why.


Improved


- Autoplan is much faster. Your plan is ready in seconds instead of about half a minute.
- Todoist tasks open in a full detail view on the task page and in the right panel, with editing.
- The Linear panel's "hide Done" now hides canceled issues too.
- The Asana panel's Filter button turns blue when a filter is hiding tasks.


Fixed


- Sorting or searching the Asana panel by due date works again on free Asana plans.
- ClickUp tasks created through MCP or the mobile app now complete in Sunsama when you close them in ClickUp. The same goes for ClickUp or Asana items added as subtasks.
- Daily shutdown shows your Sunsama tasks as highlights again instead of "No activity found".
- All-day iCloud events created in Sunsama no longer disappear from the one-day calendar view.
- Changing the channel on a past occurrence of a recurring meeting no longer reverts a moment later.
